name: StatGate end-to-end data lifecycle acceptance gate
purpose: Prove the data lifecycle works as one product (collect -> process -> store -> analyze) and fail loudly if any stage is simulated.

asserts: statdata /health == 200
statgate-core /health == 200
GET /api/v1/data/catalog/datasets without a token == 401
POST /api/v1/statistics/tabulate without the internal key == 401
source and target datasets are created (201)
an empty record batch is refused with 400
four rows store and read back
bytes_written > 0 and total_rows reflects storage
NOT_NULL quality rule created (201)
four-stage ETL pipeline created (201): EXTRACT -> VALIDATE -> TRANSFORM -> LOAD
stages.note: VALIDATE intentionally precedes TRANSFORM because the rule targets 'district', which TRANSFORM renames to 'region'. Reversing the order is a real pipeline-design defect and must surface as FAILED, not SUCCESS.

asserts: run status == SUCCESS
records_read == 4, records_written == 3, records_rejected == 1
exactly 4 stage runs
extract summary records_extracted == 4
transform summary records_in == 4 and records_out == 3
validate summary quality_status == PASSED with rules_total >= 1
load summary records_loaded == 3, bytes_written > 0, total_rows == 3
target holds exactly 3 rows
transformed rows carry 'region' and no longer carry 'district' or 'note'
catalog row_count == 3 and size_bytes > 0
a second run APPENDS: total_rows == 6 (counters derived from storage)
record reset deletes all 6 rows and the target reads back empty
a pipeline with a missing source dataset reports FAILED (never SUCCESS)
the failed run carries a non-empty error_message and writes 0 rows
the target is untouched by the failed run
a NOT_NULL violation fails at VALIDATE and names the violated rule
LOAD never executes after a failed VALIDATE (only 2 stage runs)
the clean target stays empty
tabulation bound to dataset_id returns total_record_count == 4 from stored rows
row_totals.North == 2
bogus request payload rows are ignored when dataset_id is set
no payload-only category ('Bogus') appears in the result

failure_conditions: Any pipeline run reporting SUCCESS while records_written == 0
Stage counters that disagree with the rows actually stored
A broken pipeline that does not report FAILED (guaranteed-success regression)
A failed VALIDATE that still loads rows into the target
Analytics that returns results derived from request payloads instead of persisted dataset rows
Any endpoint serving data without its credential gate (401 regression)

results.first_run_finding: The gate failed on its first execution because the pipeline validated AFTER the rename of district -> region, so the NOT_NULL rule fired and the run honestly reported FAILED. Pipeline definition corrected to validate raw extracted rows.
